author: NorthEast News Desk
body: UMass Lowell men’s soccer matched its Division I program record for goals in a game Saturday with a 5-2 road victory over Iona. Junior Marinho Oldenburg scored twice for the first goals of his college career, helping the River Hawks improve to 2-2-2 after carrying a 3-0 lead into halftime.

Sho Kinjo also scored his first career goal, while Linus Musielak contributed a goal and an assist. Ethan Agyare-Danso completed the River Hawks’ scoring. Oldenburg opened the match in the 33rd minute and finished his brace less than six minutes later, with Kinjo’s goal between them during a rapid three-goal burst.

Iona cut the margin early in the second half, but Lowell answered through Musielak and Agyare-Danso before the Gaels added a late goal. The five-goal output equaled the River Hawks’ Division I mark last reached in a 5-0 win over Central Connecticut State in 2023. Lowell visits Merrimack on Tuesday.
dek: Marinho Oldenburg scored his first two college goals as the River Hawks equaled their program record for goals in a Division I game.
headline: UMass Lowell matches Division I scoring mark in 5-2 win over Iona
